examples.name: prose-cervical-spine-xray
examples.template:
FINDINGS:
The spinal alignment is maintained without evidence of spondylolisthesis.
The vertebral body and disc space heights are preserved.
No acute fracture is identified.
The odontoid process is intact.
No lytic or blastic lesions.
The paravertebral soft tissues are normal.

IMPRESSION:
Unremarkable X-ray of the cervical spine.
examples.dictation:
straightened cervical lordosis, positional or myospasm
no fracture listhesis
no signfiicant neural foraminal stenosis

findings_edits.FINDINGS:
Straightening of the cervical lordosis, likely positional or related to muscle spasm.
No fracture or listhesis is identified.
No significant neural foraminal stenosis is present.
No lytic or blastic lesions.
The paravertebral soft tissues are normal.

output.impression: Straightening of the cervical lordosis without fracture or listhesis. No significant neural foraminal stenosis.

examples.name: sectioned-lumbar-spine
examples.template:
FINDINGS:
VERTEBRAE: Normal density and alignment. No fracture or osseous lesion.
DISC SPACES: Preserved.
SOFT TISSUES: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
No acute abnormality evident in the [generic] spine.

Mild lower lumbar facet degenerative changes.

Rest is normal.
